localBiteReport: The week of September 4–10, 2026 brought the first clear signs of the fall transition to Choctawhatchee Bay, according to the Northwest Florida Fishing Report. Large schools of baitfish (greenies) have been pushing from deeper open water into bayous, flats, and bridge areas across the bay. Slot redfish are beginning to show up on the flats and are expected to build through the second and third weeks of September as the fall mullet run gets underway — blue crab and cut/butterfly-rigged finger mullet on a single-drop rig are the recommended setups when they arrive. Water temperature measured at this location is 87°F, and the midday heat continues to push fish activity toward early morning windows. The most current reports available are from the week of September 4–10, 2026.
